patch_description: This constructor uses a topology-diverse multistart contact-search strategy rather than refining only one nearly regular lattice. It generates several staggered triangular-layer seeds with the 26-circle “defect” placed in different rows, adds coherent row-level anisotropic perturbations, and solves the full unequal-radius nonlinear program using squared-distance constraints and analytic derivatives. Squared constraints avoid repeated square roots, while the common post-solve scaling step guarantees strict validity despite optimizer tolerances.
